name: Falling For My Bodyguard
overview: After an assassination attempt on her powerful diplomat father, rebellious Harmoni Pearson is forced into hiding under a new identity with William, the young bodyguard assigned to protect her at all costs. As Harmoni rebels against the rules and tries to experience life like a normal teenager, their constant clashes spark a dangerous attraction that blurs the line between protector and forbidden love. When a betrayal exposes her identity and a kidnapping plot unfolds, Harmoni and William must fight to survive and face feelings that could change everything.
